Algebra_Structure.title: Algebra Structure
Algebra_Structure.define: An algebraic structure is a set equipped with operations whose behavior is controlled by specified axioms.

Binary_Tree.title: Binary Tree
Binary_Tree.define: A binary tree is a rooted tree in which each node has at most two children.

Bipartite_Graph.title: Bipartite Graph
Bipartite_Graph.define: A bipartite graph is a graph whose vertices can be split into two parts so that every edge connects the two parts.

Complete_Graph.title: Complete Graph
Complete_Graph.define: A complete graph is a graph in which every pair of distinct vertices is connected by an edge.

Directed_Acyclic_Graph.title: Directed Acyclic Graph
Directed_Acyclic_Graph.define: A directed acyclic graph is a directed graph with no directed cycles.

Graph.title: Graph
Graph.define: A graph is a structure made of vertices and edges that records pairwise relationships.

Lattice.title: Lattice
Lattice.define: A lattice is an ordered set in which every pair of elements has both a greatest lower bound and a least upper bound.

Ordered_Set.title: Ordered Set
Ordered_Set.define: An ordered set is a set where the elements can be compared to tell which comes before or after another.

Set.title: Set
Set.define: A set is a collection of distinct objects considered as a single mathematical object.

Tree.title: Tree
Tree.define: A tree is a connected acyclic graph.
